rules.name: cs-35-options-inputs-updated-after-20nov-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT x.value_date, x.created_by, x.updated_by, CAST(coalesce(x.updated_timestamp, x.created_timestamp) AS date) AS written_on, count(*) AS rows, min(coalesce(x.updated_timestamp, x.created_timestamp)) AS first_write, max(coalesce(x.updated_timestamp, x.created_timestamp)) AS last_write FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = 'CFS' AND x.value_date IN (DATE '2026-11-06', DATE '2026-11-19', DATE '2026-11-20') GROUP BY x.value_date, x.created_by, x.updated_by, CAST(coalesce(x.updated_timestamp, x.created_timestamp) AS date) ORDER BY x.value_date, written_on, rows DESC

SELECT x.value_date, x.created_by, x.updated_by, CAST(coalesce(x.updated_timestamp, x.created_timestamp) AS date) AS written_on, count(*) AS rows, min(coalesce(x.updated_timestamp, x.created_timestamp)) AS first_write, max(coalesce(x.updated_timestamp, x.created_timestamp)) AS last_write FROM opera.security_last_actual_value_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = 'CFS' AND x.value_date IN (DATE '2026-11-06', DATE '2026-11-19', DATE '2026-11-20') GROUP BY x.value_date, x.created_by, x.updated_by, CAST(coalesce(x.updated_timestamp, x.created_timestamp) AS date) ORDER BY x.value_date, written_on, rows DESC

SELECT DISTINCT upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, cd.contract_number, cd.security_id, s.derivative_type, s.underlying1_id, s.maturity_date FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table cd JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = cd.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = cd.business_unit AND s.security_id = cd.security_id WHERE cd.tenant_id = :tenant AND cd.business_unit = 'CFS' AND cd.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('BEG', 'ADP') ORDER BY client, cd.contract_number

SELECT x.security_id, x.value_date, x.settle_price, x.settle_delta_1, x.settle_vega_1, x.created_by, x.created_timestamp, x.updated_by, x.updated_timestamp FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = 'CFS' AND x.value_date IN (DATE '2026-11-06', DATE '2026-11-19', DATE '2026-11-20') AND x.security_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT cd.security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table cd WHERE cd.tenant_id = :tenant AND cd.business_unit = 'CFS' AND cd.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('BEG', 'ADP')) ORDER BY x.security_id, x.value_date

SELECT u.underlying_id, u.value_date, u.settlement_date, u.settle_value, u.created_by, u.created_timestamp, u.updated_by, u.updated_timestamp FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant AND u.underlying_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.underlying1_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table cd JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = cd.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = cd.business_unit AND s.security_id = cd.security_id WHERE cd.tenant_id = :tenant AND cd.business_unit = 'CFS' AND cd.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('BEG', 'ADP')) AND u.value_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-18' AND DATE '2026-11-24' ORDER BY u.underlying_id, u.value_date, u.updated_timestamp

SELECT c.contract_number, c.derivative_type, c.trade_id, c.value_date, c.settle_price, c.mtm_usd, c.created_timestamp, c.updated_timestamp FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = DATE '2026-11-20' AND upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('BEG', 'ADP') AND lower(c.derivative_type) <> 'future' ORDER BY c.contract_number
